cover.executive_summary_paragraph: The Sacramento/Florin Rd auto repair market has 4 clearly differentiated competitors within 2.1 miles. Midas Florin Rd South is the aggressive price leader, undercutting market rates on alignments by 27%. Precision Auto Care Downtown competes on volume with 13% below market pricing. Torino Auto Midtown is the growth player — gaining market share with social media activity and premium service positioning. Delta Auto & Truck recently opened nearby with premium pricing, signaling confidence in the east Sacramento market. Midtown Auto Repair's best move is to avoid competing directly on price with Midas and instead own the 'honest, customer-first' positioning that no competitor has claimed in this market.

findings.title: Own the 'Honest Shop' Positioning
findings.insight: No competitor is marketing honest, no-upsell service — but this is the #1 thing customers in reviews say they want and rarely find.
findings.why_it_matters: You can differentiate immediately without changing pricing or services.
findings.specific_action: Update your Google Business Profile description, website hero, and any advertising to lead with 'honest' and 'no surprise pricing.'

findings.title: Midas Undercuts on Alignments — Don't Match, Bundle
findings.insight: Midas Florin Rd charges 27% below market on alignments. Competing on price directly with a national chain is a losing game.
findings.why_it_matters: Bundling alignment with brake service lets you compete on value while protecting margins.
findings.specific_action: Create a 'Brake & Alignment Check' bundle. Market it as a $X value — customers get comprehensive assessment, you differentiate on expertise.

findings.title: Claim RepairPal Listing — It's Free Traffic
findings.insight: Not a single competitor in this market has claimed their RepairPal listing. RepairPal sends high-intent customers directly to shops that are listed.
findings.why_it_matters: Free, high-intent traffic that your competitors can't easily copy.
findings.specific_action: Claim your RepairPal listing this week. Add photos, services, and hours. Takes 15-20 minutes.

findings.title: Delta Auto Is the Unknown Variable
findings.insight: Delta Auto & Truck just opened in East Sacramento with premium pricing. New shops either stumble or find their footing in the first 90 days.
findings.why_it_matters: How they position themselves in the next few months will determine whether they become a threat or just another competitor.
findings.specific_action: Monitor Delta Auto's Google listing, reviews, and pricing for the next 90 days. Adjust if they start gaining significant share.

findings.title: Social Media Is Completely Uncontested
findings.insight: No competitor has active social media presence. Torino Auto shows the most activity signals but has not claimed the space.
findings.why_it_matters: A consistent Instagram presence with shop photos, customer testimonials, and service education will build an audience that competitors can't easily replicate.
findings.specific_action: Start with Instagram — post 3x per week. Shop photos, before/after brake jobs, and 'how it works' content. No competitor is doing this.
